metric_interpretation.rmse: Penalizes large dollar mistakes more strongly.
metric_interpretation.mae: Average absolute dollar error; easiest to communicate.
metric_interpretation.rmsle: Better for skewed house prices and relative error behavior.
metric_interpretation.r2: Explained variance, useful but not sufficient alone.

selection_rule: Use CV RMSE to select a model, then inspect MAE/RMSLE/residuals before trusting it.
